title: Buoyant colour
when: Friendly launches, creative events and optimistic stories with rounded expressive forms
rules: Choose bubble-cluster, inflated-loop, ribbon-wave or petal-burst; alternate geometry rather than just recolouring a scene.
Float or rotate the hero slowly; use a decisive entrance for copy.
Keep the copy region quiet and limit each shot to one main idea.
Use palette tokens and native type; reserve full-frame colour and graphic wipes for story turns.
